command:
set -euo pipefail
{
  ownership_diff=$(rtk proxy /usr/bin/comm -3 <(rtk proxy git diff --name-only 951593f7a2ea11db7e14b9154afd46cbbf96f870..HEAD | rtk sort -u) <({ rtk jq -r '.entries[] | select(.owner == \"stage_b\" or .owner == \"mixed\") | .path' strike/constitution-seal-inventory.json; print -r -- tests/unit/webserver/constitutionRecoveryConsumerJourney.dom.test.tsx; } | rtk sort -u))
  if [[ -n "$ownership_diff" ]]; then
    print -r -- "$ownership_diff"
    print -r -- 'OWNERSHIP_DIFF=1'
    exit 1
  fi
  print -r -- 'OWNERSHIP_DIFF=0'
} > /tmp/wayland-con-b-ownership.log 2>&1
